paragraphs.text: Northbridge Swimming Club welcomes swimmers aged 16 and over of all abilities. New members are asked to attend a short assessment session so that coaches can place them in a suitable group. Assessments take place on the first Sunday of each month.
Training sessions are held at Northbridge Leisure Pool on Monday and Wednesday evenings and on Saturday mornings. Members may attend as many sessions as they like each week.
The annual fee is £120, which can be paid in one sum or in four equal payments. Members who join after 1 July pay half the annual fee for their first year.
The club takes part in local competitions, but competing is entirely optional. Many members join simply to improve their fitness.

Swimmers should bring their own goggles and swimming cap. Towels can be hired at the pool reception, and lockers are free to use. Please arrive ten minutes before your session so that it can start on time.
The finance and sales departments will move to the new building on Carter Street over the weekend of 14–15 June. All other departments will remain at the current site until September.

Staff moving on 14–15 June should pack their personal items into the boxes provided by 5 pm on Friday 13 June. Removal staff will not pack personal items, and the company cannot be responsible for items that are not packed.
Computers will be disconnected and moved by the IT team. Staff do not need to do anything with their equipment, but they should make sure their files are saved to the shared drive.

The new building has parking for 40 cars. Spaces will be given first to staff who have a disability, and then to those who share cars. Everyone else is encouraged to use the bus, which stops directly outside.
If you have any questions about the move, please speak to your line manager or contact the facilities team, who will be on site throughout the weekend.

items.quote: welcomes swimmers aged 16 and over of all abilities
items.prompt: The club accepts swimmers who are 15 years old.

explanation.en: The club takes swimmers “aged 16 and over”. A 15-year-old does not meet this condition → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Клубқа он алты жастан бастап қабылдайды: «aged 16 and over». Он бес жастағы жүзуші бұл шартқа сай келмейді → FALSE.
explanation.ru: В клуб принимают с шестнадцати лет: «aged 16 and over». Пятнадцатилетний пловец под это условие не подходит → FALSE.

items.quote: so that coaches can place them in a suitable group
items.prompt: Coaches use the assessment to decide which group a new member joins.

explanation.en: The assessment exists “so that coaches can place them in a suitable group” — coaches use it to put new members in a group → TRUE.
explanation.kk: Бағалау сабағы «so that coaches can place them in a suitable group» үшін өтеді — бапкерлер жаңа мүшелерді топқа сол бойынша бөледі → TRUE.
explanation.ru: Оценочное занятие нужно, «so that coaches can place them in a suitable group» — тренеры по нему распределяют новичков по группам → TRUE.

items.quote: Members may attend as many sessions as they like each week
items.prompt: Members are allowed to train only twice a week.
keywords: as many sessions as they like

explanation.en: “as many sessions as they like each week” — there is no limit. The timetable is not a “twice a week” rule → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «as many sessions as they like each week» — шектеу жоқ. Кестедегі үш күн «twice» деген шек емес → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «as many sessions as they like each week» — ограничения нет. Три дня тренировок в расписании не значат лимит «twice» → FALSE.

items.quote: can be paid in one sum or in four equal payments
items.prompt: The annual fee can be paid in instalments.

explanation.en: The fee can be paid “in one sum or in four equal payments”. Paying in four parts is paying in instalments → TRUE.
explanation.kk: Жарнаны «in one sum or in four equal payments» төлеуге болады. Төрт рет төлеу — бөліп төлеу, яғни «instalments» → TRUE.
explanation.ru: Взнос можно внести «in one sum or in four equal payments». Четыре платежа — это и есть оплата частями, «instalments» → TRUE.

items.quote: The club takes part in local competitions
items.prompt: The club’s swimmers have won several local competitions.

explanation.en: “takes part in local competitions” — it takes part, but nothing is said about winning → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: «takes part in local competitions» — қатысады, бірақ жеңіс туралы ештеңе айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: «takes part in local competitions» — участвует, но о победах ничего не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Read Text A. Do the following statements agree with the information given in the text? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

items.quote: All other departments will remain at the current site until September
items.prompt: All departments will move to Carter Street in June.

explanation.en: Only finance and sales move in June; “All other departments will remain … until September” → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Маусымда тек қаржы мен сату бөлімдері көшеді; «All other departments will remain … until September» → FALSE.
explanation.ru: В июне переезжают только финансы и продажи; «All other departments will remain … until September» → FALSE.

items.quote: pack their personal items into the boxes provided
items.prompt: Boxes for packing will be supplied to staff.

explanation.en: Staff pack “into the boxes provided”, so the company gives them boxes. “Supplied” = “provided” → TRUE.
explanation.kk: Қызметкерлер заттарын «into the boxes provided» салады — қорапты компания береді. «Supplied» = «provided» → TRUE.
explanation.ru: Сотрудники складывают вещи «into the boxes provided» — коробки им выдаёт компания. «Supplied» = «provided» → TRUE.

items.quote: Computers will be disconnected and moved by the IT team
items.prompt: Staff must disconnect their own computers before the move.

explanation.en: Computers are “disconnected and moved by the IT team”, and staff “do not need to do anything with their equipment”. They do not disconnect anything themselves → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Компьютерлерді «disconnected and moved by the IT team», ал қызметкерлерге «do not need to do anything with their equipment». Техниканы өздері ажыратпайды → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Компьютеры «disconnected and moved by the IT team», а сотрудникам «do not need to do anything with their equipment». Отключать технику самим не нужно → FALSE.

items.quote: The new building has parking for 40 cars
items.prompt: The new building has a canteen for staff.

explanation.en: The only facilities mentioned are parking and the bus stop. A canteen is not mentioned → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Жаңа ғимарат туралы тек тұрақ пен автобус айтылған. Асхана туралы бір сөз жоқ → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: О новом здании сказано только про парковку и автобус. Про столовую — ни слова → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: Spaces will be given first to staff who have a disability, and then to those who share cars
items.prompt: Staff who share cars will be offered parking before most other employees.

explanation.en: Staff with a disability come first, “and then to those who share cars”; everyone else is told to take the bus. So before most others → TRUE.
explanation.kk: Алдымен мүмкіндігі шектеулі қызметкерлер, «and then to those who share cars», қалғандары автобуспен барады. Демек көпшіліктен бұрын → TRUE.
explanation.ru: Сначала сотрудники с инвалидностью, «and then to those who share cars», все остальные — на автобус. Значит, раньше большинства → TRUE.
